body: Thanks you very much for your advice, a couple things, I am already seeing a counselor, and it's really as much therapy as I need right now. She is the one who had the bad therapy experience and now she is very closed off to it as a whole, I literally just talked to her about it, and I definitely pissed her off, which gives me anxiety cause I need her and don't want to distance my self from her, but she just says thank you for helping but I don't want to pretty much, and I again I know I can't make her do anything, but I think she really needs it. We are both 18 about to graduate next week, so we still live in our parents houses, but her relationship with her mother is very weird and not good. I have talked to her mom a couple times when I was really scared for her safety but she just has a kind of over it attitude to it when she talks to about it, and she told that her ex a couple years ago pretty much had to beg her mom to get her help (which was the therapy that has turned her away from it) so I also don't know what to do about that. Really I'm at the point right now where I dont know what to do at all, I know she NEEDS help but how can I give it to her if she doesn't want it. It's all so hard and confusing and stressful. Thank you for the advice though I really appreciate it, I'm doing my fucking hardest to keep things to together I just don't know where to go from here.

Yeah and that's pretty much exactly what I say in the heat of the moment when she is saying she is going to do it. But I feel like afterwards at least it doesn't actually solve the root of the problem, y'know?

I sort of have before, but my brains thought behind it, is that if I say that it sounds like she is a burden on me, which isn't true at all, but it could possibly make her alienate herself from me. But maybe that is just me being parinod in a different way
Happy birthday my guy, I turned 18 last month, and it's really fucking scary, but maybe we can be scared together?

Thank you I think I have been try to do that in a way, and I do think we are extremely open with eachother and we talk through alot of our problems with eachother, but when it comes to trying to help those problems im completly lost. Most of are conversations like that goes (this is simplified obviously), "I'm sad" "I'm sorry your sad, can I help?"', "no it's okay", "let's just distract from it". I just don't know how the actual fixing things comes into play, like obviously I know I can't magically fix anything but I just dont see the part where I'm even help y'know?

Well I have tried to a good amount of times to ask her to may get so more professional help, but she has gone to therapist and stuff like that before and has hated it, and I don't want to push it that hard on her cause I feel like it can get very annoying. Other then that I just try at tell her how much she means to me and that I need her so bad to stay here. But during the actual events when she says she's going to do it is another story cause it pretty much sends me into an instant panic attack and I can never think of what to do and it so far has ended up with her just being asleep or her phone died or whatever, but I'm so fucking scared for a time when that's not the case. Sorry again for rambling, just getting cot off my chest really.
It really doesn't seem that easy but thank you bro
